claim: When replaying Codex review fixes onto an existing PT PR branch, verify the live PR branch first and re-apply only the missing behavioral delta; prior commit hashes or summaries may come from a different rewritten ancestry.

decisions.notes: PR #256 already contained earlier canonical resolver work from main, so the safe fix was to compare current branch behavior and apply the remaining bare/external common-dir and test isolation deltas on the same PR branch.
